manifest.title_fil: Mangolekta ng impormasyon sa posibleng pagkalason
objectives_fil: Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
objectives_en: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Maaaring nakalunok ng panlinis ang isang bata
sections.takeaway_en: Case: A child may have swallowed an unknown household cleaner

sections.takeaway_fil: Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
sections.takeaway_en: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.

check.prompt_fil: Sa kasong ito, ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: In this case, what comes first?

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.
Move away and call for advice.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment. 2: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag pasukahin, rutinang painumin nang marami, mag-imbento ng panlunas, o umasa sa isang nakatakdang distansya sa chemical spill. 3: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary assessment may be delayed. 2: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not induce vomiting, give a routine large drink, improvise an antidote, or assume a fixed distance makes a chemical spill safe. 3: Prioritize safety and timely help.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
sections.takeaway_en: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral. 2: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis. 3: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag pasukahin, rutinang painumin nang marami, mag-imbento ng panlunas, o umasa sa isang nakatakdang distansya sa chemical spill.
check.feedback_en: 1: Observe the task and appropriate referral. 2: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis. 3: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not induce vomiting, give a routine large drink, improvise an antidote, or assume a fixed distance makes a chemical spill safe.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
